title: GMKtec G3 Ultra Mini PC Intel Pentium Gold 7505 3.5GHz 16GB LPDDR4 512GB
writeup: The GMKtec G3 Ultra is a complete desktop PC small enough to tuck behind a monitor. It uses an Intel Pentium Gold 7505 processor with 16GB of LPDDR4 memory and a 512GB drive, which is enough for everyday work, browsing, and a compact home-server setup. It is $284.98 new. No other store listing for this exact model was found to compare against.
